title: The 10 Best Portable Tool Boxes
subtitle: Ranked from live Amazon data — best-sellers, real ratings, honest trade-offs.
intro: We pulled the best-selling hand-carry tool boxes on Amazon — classic cantilever trays, stackable modular cases, small portable drawer boxes, and totes — then scored each one on a single 100-point scale built from its star rating, review volume, value, and the features that matter when a box has to travel. Here is where each lands.

Added the CRAFTSMAN CMST16901, STANLEY 028001L, DEWALT TSTAK DWST17804 and DWST17814, Plano 452-006, Torin ATRJH-3430T and Milwaukee PACKOUT 48-22-8442 (the new Money No Object pick). products.name: Milwaukee 48-22-8425 PACKOUT Large Tool Box
products.verdict: The modern standard. Impact-proof, weather-sealed, and the box the whole PACKOUT system stacks and locks onto — the highest-rated portable box here.
pros: The best-rated, most-trusted box in the PACKOUT line
IP65 weather seal keeps tools dry
Locks and stacks with every PACKOUT unit
cons: Pricey next to a plain hand box
The system tempts you into buying more boxes

products.name: CRAFTSMAN Tool Box, Lockable, 16 in., Red/Black (CMST16901)
products.verdict: A basic 16-inch box with a metal front latch, a padlock eye and a lift-out tray, from a brand you can find in any hardware store. It's the best-selling box in this search, with more than 4,000 sold last month.
pros: Under $20 with a metal latch and padlock eye
Lift-out tray for small hand tools
cons: Doesn't stack or lock into a modular system

products.name: STANLEY 28 in. Structural Foam Portable Toolbox, Heavy Duty (028001L)
products.verdict: The long box on this list: 28 inches, so a level, a handsaw or a pry bar fits flat. Structural foam walls and a water-resistant rating. Amazon's listing has no feature bullets, so we can't confirm the latch or tray details.
cons: Listing gives a 10 lb maximum load, low for a box this size
No feature details published on the listing

products.name: CRAFTSMAN CMST20901 20 in. Lockable Tool Box with Tray
products.verdict: The lockable classic. A 20 in box that's padlock-ready, with a cantilever tray and see-through lid windows — a small step up from the Stanley for security.
pros: Cantilever tray lifts up and out of the way
Lid windows show contents without opening

products.name: DEWALT TSTAK Tool Storage Organizer with Double Drawers (DWST17804)
products.verdict: Two ball-bearing drawers with removable dividers for bits, screws and small parts, in a unit that latches onto the rest of the TSTAK line. Over 1,000 sold last month.
pros: Stacks and latches with other TSTAK boxes
4,101 reviews at 4.7 stars, limited lifetime warranty

products.name: DEWALT TSTAK Tool Box, Deep, Long Handle, Water and Debris Resistant (DWST17814)
products.verdict: The deep TSTAK box, 13.25 inches tall, for drills and other bulky power tools. Rust-resistant metal latches, a water and debris seal, and fixed dividers in the lid for bits.

Metal latches and a water-resistant rating
Other TSTAK units stack underneath it

products.name: DEWALT DWST17806 TSTAK Deep Tool Box
products.verdict: The deep TSTAK box. A tall single-latch case with a lift-out tote tray that stacks with the rest of the TSTAK line — great for a full hand-tool loadout.

Among the best-rated boxes in the TSTAK line

products.name: Plano 452-006 Grab-N-Go 16-Inch Tool Box with Tray
products.verdict: The cheapest box here and one of the best rated: a 3 lb, 16-inch plastic box with a lift-out tray and two small removable organizers. Fine for a kitchen-drawer tool kit.

products.verdict: A cantilever box: open the lid and three tiers of trays fold out so you can see everything at once. Metal latches and a clear lid compartment for small parts, at 1.6 lbs empty.

products.name: Milwaukee PACKOUT 2-Drawer Tool Box (48-22-8442)
products.verdict: Two full-width drawers in a PACKOUT unit that locks onto the 48-22-8425 box on this page and the rest of the system. The pick if you're already on PACKOUT and want drawers on the jobsite.
pros: Locks into the Milwaukee PACKOUT system

buyers_guide.q: Cantilever box, stackable case, or drawer box?
buyers_guide.a: A cantilever-lid box (Stanley, Craftsman) is the cheapest, lightest way to carry a mixed load with small parts up top. A stackable modular case (TSTAK, PACKOUT, ToughSystem) costs more but locks together and travels as a tower. A portable steel drawer box gives you real drawer organization you can still carry. Match the style to how the box moves.

buyers_guide.q: Do I need a weather-sealed box?
buyers_guide.a: If your tools ride in an open truck bed or sit on a wet job site, an IP65-rated box like the PACKOUT or ToughSystem keeps rain and dust out. For a garage or a covered van, a plain plastic box is fine and far cheaper.

Load ratings run from about 30 lb for a light plastic hand box to 110 lb for a ToughSystem case. Be honest about what you carry — a box packed with sockets and a drill kit gets heavy, and an over-stuffed light box will crack a latch or bow the lid.

Latches are the first thing to fail on a cheap box. Metal or metal-reinforced latches (even the sub-$30 Stanley and Craftsman have them) last far longer than all-plastic clasps, especially in the cold.

buyers_guide.q: Should I buy into a stacking system?
buyers_guide.a: Only if you'll use more than one box. The value of TSTAK, PACKOUT, and ToughSystem is that boxes and organizers click together and roll on a shared cart. Buy a single box from a system and you pay the system premium without the payoff.

avoid.name: VEVOR Metal Tool Box, 20.5-inch, Portable Metal Tool Box with 3 Drawers (TBD-2003SSBK)
avoid.flag: Lists two load ratings: 61.6 lbs and 15 lbs
avoid.verdict: A steel drawer box whose listing can't agree with itself on how much it holds, and that weighs almost 18 lbs before you put a tool in it. The DEWALT TSTAK 2-drawer unit on this page costs about half as much.
reasons: The listing's Capacity field says 61.6 pounds; its Maximum Weight Recommendation says 15 pounds. Both can't be right, and the difference matters if you plan to fill the drawers with sockets.
It weighs 17.9 lbs empty, according to the listing, nearly as much as the Milwaukee PACKOUT 2-drawer unit (20.1 lbs, rated for 50 lbs), and it's carried by a single top handle.
The drawers are 1.73 inches deep inside. That fits wrenches and sockets but not much else.
The body is 0.6 mm steel, thin enough that a drop will dent it.
